Marco: Hey team — I just noticed my last two payouts show 1099 contractor gross but my status says I converted to W-2 on 2026-02-01. Looks like taxes weren’t withheld for Feb payroll. Can payroll confirm?

Tanya (Payroll): Thanks for flagging, Marco. Can you paste the paystub links and your employee conversion request date? We should have a conversion record.

Marco: paystub links: https://files.redwood.internal/paystubs/marco-0126.pdf and https://files.redwood.internal/paystubs/marco-0210.pdf. Conversion approved doc in HR: conv_marco_20260201.pdf (uploaded 2026-02-01 09:10).

Asha (People Ops): I approved the conversion 2026-02-01 at 09:05 and pushed the status to payroll. HR shows effective date 2026-02-01.

Tanya (Payroll): Pulling logs... quick triage shows payroll snapshot for payrun-20260210-01 took employee classification from the contractor ledger because our nightly sync pulled HR snapshot from 2026-01-31 (one day before the conversion record). So Feb 10 ran as 1099. We'll need to: 1) reclassify the Feb payrun as W-2, 2) withhold and remit employee payroll taxes retroactively, and 3) issue a net withholding reclaim or off-cycle deduction depending on Marco's preference.

PayrollBot: Ticket PR-2026-212 opened by Tanya. Priority: high. Actions: reprocess payrun-20260210-01, compute retro tax liability, create journal entries for employer taxes, prepare employee notice.

Marco: Oof. Can you do netting instead of taking a large pay deduction? I prefer payroll to gross-up or spread withholding over next two pay periods if possible.

Ben (Finance): From a finance perspective we can either 1) withhold the missing taxes in one off-cycle deduction, 2) spread it over N regular payrolls (requires employee consent), or 3) issue an employee repayment invoice. Many teams choose to spread across 2 pay periods to reduce cash shock. Need Marco's preference documented.

Tanya (Payroll): We'll compute exact tax delta. Quick note: employer-side taxes (FICA, FUTA, state unemployment) need to be recorded and paid by the employer; employee-side (Fed withholding + employee FICA) can be collected via off-cycle or prorated consent. Marco, please confirm if you consent to a two-pay-period spread for employee-side withholding.

Marco: I consent to spreading the employee-side withholding over two pay periods.

Tanya (Payroll): Got it. We will: A) reprocess payrun-20260210-01 as W-2 (retro), B) calculate employee tax delta = $1,248.63, employer tax delta = $285.47, C) apply employee withholding spread over next 2 runs (deduct ~$624.32 each), D) record employer liability and remit. We'll also generate an updated year-to-date statement and determine whether a W-2C is required.

PayrollBot: PR-2026-212 update: reprocess complete 2026-02-12T13:11Z. Tax calc summary:
```
original_net_paid (as 1099): $4,500.00
recomputed_net (as W-2 before collect): $3,251.37
employee_tax_delta: $1,248.63
employer_tax_delta: $285.47
```

PayrollBot: Off-cycle withholding scheduled: two deductions of $624.32 on next payruns (payrun-20260224-01 and payrun-20260310-01). Employer payroll liabilities recorded to JE #JE-2026-187.

Marco: Thanks. Will this trigger a W-2C for 2026? I want to make sure my tax filings are correct.

Tanya (Payroll): Good question. Because the payments were originally processed as contractor (1099) and then reclassified, we will review reporting. If an original 1099-MISC/NEC was issued or submitted to IRS for those payments, we may need to retract and issue a corrected W-2 (i.e., W-2 instead of 1099). Typically we: 1) assess whether a 1099 was filed/submitted, 2) if filed, coordinate with Tax Ops to file corrections (1099 void + W-2 issuance), 3) prepare W-2C if year-end W-2 was produced previously. For mid-year conversions we often avoid W-2C if year-end reporting will reflect net corrected totals; we'll confirm after we check filings.

Ben (Finance): FYI accounting will pick up JE-2026-187 in the monthly close. Also tagging Tax Ops to review whether IRS correction filings are required.

PayrollBot: PR-2026-212 closed by Tanya on 2026-02-13T09:40Z. Close notes: reprocess done, employee consent recorded for two-pay spread, off-cycle deductions scheduled, employer JE posted, tax ops notified for reporting review.

Marco: Confirmed first deduction posted on 2026-02-24. Thank you all for the quick handling.

Asha (People Ops): We'll add a checklist reminder to ensure payroll snapshots run after conversions are processed to avoid this recurrence. Thanks for the patience.
